response.original_title: King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard: Live at The Salt Shed, Chicago – June 13, 2023
response.overview: The rain-soaked finale of King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard's three-night Chicago residency, filmed outdoors at The Salt Shed on June 13, 2023 during the band's 2023 U.S. Residency Tour. Played through a downpour that flooded the stage and forced the setlist to be reshuffled mid-show to keep the synths dry, the eleven-song set opens with "Gila Monster", delivers the live debut of "Change", revives "Plastic Boogie" for the first time in a year with a "Black Dog" outro, and closes with an extended "The Dripping Tap".
response.title: King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard: Live at The Salt Shed, Chicago – June 13, 2023
